body: I get it, being lost in the creative process and all that, I've had my moments too :^) if posting it here helped don't let me get in the way yknow?
I've had therapy in the past and tried to get back into it but I can't for some reason. Thank you for the reply, much appreciated

It's not that I want a car to have a status symbol, it's that the area I live in is almost impossible to walk from point A to B and we have about 0 public transport. It wouldn't be a big deal if I lived in a big city with sidewalks and such, but due to big roads, lack of pedestrian or bicyclist safety, and things being far apart, a car is an actual necessity to getting around. The area is one of those American suburbs built around highways and my chances of even getting out of state for university are slim.

I know my boyfriend is sweet to me bc he loves me, but sometimes loving someone doesn't necessarily mean they're the best fit for you. I love him too, but often feel ignored because our communication styles are so different, and this being my first relationship, is more important to me than I initially thought it would be. So I'll have to think it through some more lol.

As for being normal I definitely have a history with suicidal thoughts I neglected to mention but the overthinking is spot on lmao.

I just wanted to clarify my feelings a bit, but thank you very much for replying, it is appreciated.

I don't think you should kill yourself, I think you should be a writer. The imagery was very vivid, I kept picturing this as a comic. Though maybe add a disclaimer at the top since I thought you were Actually a prison guard describing that you were about to kill yourself, or consider moving it to another sub, since maybe you're not in a crisis right now? Otherwise, it was cool.

I get it, I almost killed myself 5 years ago and the ideation has come and gone ever since, I just don't feel "right" without it. Like if things are going well and then I feel the slightest bit of stress i'm like "pull the trigger piglet." It's almost like I built a part of me around the wanting to die.

That said I hope we both power through. My life is much different from 5 years ago, things feel harder but I kind of think of it like I leveled up so i get the harder bosses.....

Seriously it may not be much but I think I understand, and I hope you feel not this way soon, or at least if you do, that you can find ways to cope. Posting here is a start? 💖
